correctness.rationale: For positive E=e^(τA), fixing s1*s2=q fixes the determinant qd and leaves trace ux+qv/x on [q,1]. The positive discriminant and determinant make the Perron root strictly increasing in the trace. The unique trace minimum is the projected square-root critical point (q=1 is a singleton); sqrt(q) is interior for q<1, where it is stationary exactly when u=v. For the example, independently reducing the exponential via eigenvalues 1 and −3 gives u=53/64, v=83/64, d=1/4 and ρ(E)=2. On the balanced branch the minimum is sqrt(q)(sqrt(uv)+sqrt(uv−d)). Its unit crossing is interior and gives the smaller root of 64q²−3887q+1024; the other branch cannot recross because scaling any feasible larger-product optimum down gives a strictly smaller multiplier at the smaller product. Equal treatment crosses at 1/4. The rational witness checks by determinant 13/200 and characteristic polynomial at 1 equal to 59/9600. Long et al.'s hypotheses for fixation are satisfied; upper comparison with full resistance proves extinction, and eventual lower comparison with a common factor (1−ε) of full resistance proves growth under strict inequalities. The analysis does not classify neutral nonlinear dynamics; the multiplier at the optimum is 1 at q_c, not necessarily for every split.
